exceptions.cause: Content, not layout. The live home page's blog strip is a Webflow collection list that shows 3 random posts of 10, chosen when the origin renders and then CDN-cached; on the capture date it showed watching-movies, the-subtle-art and design-and-the-question. The clone renders a fixed three (mobile-first, the-subtle-art, why-a-button), so two of three cards carry a different image and title, and title wrapping makes the section 1444.8 px against 1424.1 px. Evidence: layout matches (geoPct 100.0 at 390, 99.2 at 1440; inkPct 96.9); the same section passes the gate at 1440 (82.5) because most of the area is white; the live site re-captured in a second and a third run gave the identical three posts (live-vs-live control 100.0). It is therefore live content, not harness noise. Pinning the clone to one random draw was deliberately not done. Needs a human decision.
